hero.heading: Understand Bitcoin the right way — through precise explanations, transparent guidance, and meaningful technical depth

core_identity.label: Our Core Identity
core_identity.body: Pan-African Bitcoin Academy is an open-source Bitcoin education infrastructure about Bitcoin from first principles and builds long-term technical and contributor capacity in underserved communities.

mission.heading: Educating with Clarity, Honesty & Rigor
mission.body: Pan-African Bitcoin Academy exists to help people across Africa learn Bitcoin the right way — with clarity, honesty, and technical depth. Our mission is to create a trusted learning environment where anyone can understand how Bitcoin truly works: keys, UTXOs, transactions, mining, blocks, wallets, and responsible self-custody.
mission.quote: “The best thing you can do for yourself is to have the knowledge.”
mission.disclaimer_1: This is not a hype platform. This is not a trading academy.
mission.disclaimer_2: This is a place for real knowledge, real skills, and real empowerment.

group_1.title: 1) New learners and curious beginners
items: Understand Bitcoin deeply as a system, not a price chart
Protect yourself from scams and common mistakes
Safely use wallets and practice responsible self-custody

group_2.title: 2) People who want detailed Bitcoin technology
group_2.body: Go beyond "what is Bitcoin?" and get a structured foundation in how the protocol works.

group_3.title: 3) Future Bitcoin and Lightning developers
group_3.body: We don't run a coding bootcamp, but we provide roadmaps, curated resources, mentor connections, events, hackathons, and guidance to start contributing to Bitcoin Core, wallets, and Lightning.

developer_support.heading: How we support new developers
items: Curated library of Bitcoin, wallet, and Lightning development resources
Pathways to Bitcoin Core, Lightning, and wallet builder communities
Access to mentors, guest speakers, and local/online meetups
Introductions to open-source projects, events, and hackathons
Guidance on contributing to wallets, tools, and Bitcoin OSS projects

community.heading: A growing community — open to all
community.body: Connected to the Pan-African and global Bitcoin ecosystem. We welcome mentors, guest lecturers, Bitcoin developers, educators, open-source contributors, builders, wallet creators, Lightning enthusiasts, and anyone who wants to support African learners.

students_as_contributors.heading: Our students become contributors
students_as_contributors.body: Graduates are encouraged to write about their learning journey, share safety lessons, explain the challenges they faced, and teach future cohorts. Many go on to mentor, lecture, or contribute to the curriculum and community resources.

what_we_dont_do.heading: What we do NOT do
items: We do NOT give investment advice or push anyone to invest.
We focus on knowledge, security, self-custody skills, technical understanding, and scam awareness so you can protect yourself.

evolving.heading: An evolving project
evolving.body: The academy keeps growing as more students join, mentors participate, developers contribute, and communities share resources. Together, we can build a movement of informed, empowered, and technically skilled African Bitcoin developers and builders.
